pages.intro: Möbius Studio (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information about you when you visit our website.

body.html: When you interact with our Site, we may collect personal details you choose to share, such as:

items: Name
Email address
Company name
Phone number
Any other details you include when contacting us or signing up for updates

body.html: We may also collect technical data automatically, including:

items: IP address
Browser type and version
Device information
Referring websites
Pages visited and time spent on the Site
Cookies and similar tracking technologies

body.html: We use the collected information to:

items: Respond to inquiries and provide requested services
Maintain, operate, and improve the Site
Personalize and enhance your experience
Analyze Site performance and usage
Protect our systems and prevent misuse

body.html: We never sell your personal information. We may share limited data only when necessary:

items: Service Providers: With trusted partners who help operate our Site or provide related services (hosting, analytics, email delivery).
Legal Requirements: If required by law or to protect our rights and comply with legal processes.
Business Changes: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or restructuring, data may be transferred to a successor entity.

body.html: We use cookies and similar tools to enhance browsing experience and gather analytics. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work as intended.
We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes outlined in this policy, unless longer retention is required by law.
We take reasonable measures to protect your data. However, no system is fully secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute protection. You use the Site at your own risk.
Our Site may include links to other websites. We are not responsible for the privacy or content practices of those sites. Please review their privacy policies separately.
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

items: Access, correct, or delete your data
Withdraw consent for processing
Opt out of marketing communications

body.html: You can contact us to exercise these rights at hello@mobius.studio
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Updates will appear on this page with a revised effective date. Your continued use of the Site means you accept the updated terms.

faqSection.heading: Questions, answered.
faqSection.learnMore: Learn more about the people and principles behind Learn more about the people and principles behind Möbius®.

items.q: How do you start a new project?
items.a: We start by listening. Every project begins with a short discovery phase where we learn about your goals, challenges, and expectations. From there, we define the creative direction, map out deliverables, and set a timeline that balances clarity with craft.

items.q: Can you help with strategy, not just design?
items.a: Yes — strategy is part of everything we do. Before we design, we help define your message, audience, and positioning. That foundation shapes how your brand looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope and level of detail. A small website or brand refresh may take around 4–6 weeks, while larger, more complex projects often need 8–12 weeks. We always plan collaboratively to make sure deadlines fit both sides.

items.q: What if I don’t know exactly what I need?
items.a: That’s completely fine. Many collaborations start that way. We’ll guide you through a short discovery process to clarify your goals and define what makes the most impact — whether it’s a rebrand, a digital experience, or something entirely new.

cta.text: Still have questions? Let’s talk about your project and how we can help.
